qualification.details: Project Research Scientist I (non-medical): Essential: MBBS/BDS; Desirable: Research experience preferably in oncology, experience in research grant writing, protocol development, research paper publication and research methodologies, skilled in using modern software and tools, experience working in information and knowledge management and/or communication projects in oncology, data analysis, project writing, scientific research publication, and article writing Project Nurse I: Essential: Two years Auxiliary Nurse & Midwife (ANM) course OR Graduate degree in Nursing; Desirable: Knowledge of IT applications and MS-Office, experience in performing data, data cleaning, and generating queries

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) and 1 for Project Nurse I.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (non-medical): Essential: MBBS/BDS; Desirable: Research experience preferably in oncology, experience in research grant writing, protocol development, research paper publication and research methodologies, skilled in using modern software and tools, experience working in information and knowledge management and/or communication projects in oncology, data analysis, project writing, scientific research publication, and article writing Project Nurse I: Essential: Two years Auxiliary Nurse & Midwife (ANM) course OR Graduate degree in Nursing; Desirable: Knowledge of IT applications and MS-Office, experience in performing data, data cleaning, and generating queries

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) for various project-based positions. It offers a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names available?
faq.answer: The available post names are Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) and Project Nurse - I. These roles are contractual and offer valuable experience in a research environment.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced in this AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026. One vacancy is for Project Research Scientist I and one for Project Nurse - I.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist I and Project Nurse - I posts is 24 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official online portal of AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for Project Research Scientist I (non-medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) must possess an MBBS or BDS degree. Desirable qualifications include research experience, grant writing, and data analysis skills.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Project Nurse - I?
faq.answer: The Project Nurse - I position offers a salary of 18000/- + 30% HRA per month. This contractual role provides a good remuneration package for qualified nursing professionals.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist I and Project Nurse - I posts. Applications are free of cost.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment includes shortlisting of applications, followed by a walk-in interview, and finally, document verification. Candidates must clear all stages.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for these Project Research Scientist I (non-medical) and Project Nurse - I posts is Delhi, specifically at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi campus.
